title: Compile budget: the cell server without tokio; the gawd-agents HTTP edge measured
goal: Take tokio out of susi-abi so the host build's susi-core never waits for the async runtime: the shared swarm-cell TCP server becomes standard library only (std::net listener, one thread per connection, synchronous handlers, a handler panic answered as an Error status), the cell-server feature and the optional tokio edge leave susi-abi, and the gawd, gemi and gmcp cell binaries run their blocking work on the connection thread without an async main. Measure the cold `cargo build -p susi` idle, three runs alternating with origin/main, record where susi-core and susi-gawd-agents start and what unblocks them, and evaluate susi-gawd-agents' direct susi-http-transport edge (and its susi-adapters-llm edge) against core's std client.
acceptance: cargo test -p susi-abi --lib cell_server --offline --locked passes: a bad token is denied without trust decay, an empty expected token denies every syscall, NotFound/Timeout/Error statuses decay trust, malformed and non-request frames are ignored while a corrupt stream drops the connection, a panicking handler is answered with an Error on a connection that stays up, and a heartbeat on one connection is answered while another connection's syscall is still running; every read and wait is bounded.
